equations: \underline{X} = \begin{pmatrix} x_1 \\ x_2 \\ \dots \\ \dots \\ x_n \end{pmatrix} \Rightarrow \underline{X} = \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ x_1 \\ x_2 \\ \dots \\ \dots \\ x_n \end{pmatrix}   (label: Ugmented Vector)
\underline{W} = \begin{pmatrix} b \\ w_1 \\ w_2 \\ \dots \\ \dots \\ w_n \end{pmatrix}   (label: Model Weights; b is red, w's black)

d(\underline{X}) = \underline{W}^T \, \underline{X} = w_1x_1 + w_2x_2 + ..... + w_nx_n + b*1 \Rightarrow \left\{ \begin{array}{l} >0 \Rightarrow \text{Class I} \\ <0 \Rightarrow \text{Class II} \\ =0 \Rightarrow \text{Undefined Class} \end{array} \right.
